summary.description: One to three sentences on what the PR does and the overall verdict.

findings.description: Defects introduced or exposed by this PR. May be empty.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the changed file, e.g. src/api/orders.py, app/Services/Orders.php, or web/src/orders.ts.

line.description: Line number in the new version of the file.

failure_path.description: GitHub-flavored Markdown. Concrete inputs or state, the code path taken, and the wrong outcome. Separate paragraphs with a blank line, and put any multi-line code excerpt in a fenced block with a language tag.

evidence.description: GitHub-flavored Markdown. What was read in the repository that proves the defect. At most three short paragraphs separated by blank lines. Put code excerpts in fenced blocks with a language tag (for example ```python), not in single-line inline code spans; reserve inline backticks for short identifiers, paths, and values.

suggestion.description: GitHub-flavored Markdown. The minimal fix. When the fix is code, include the replacement in a fenced block with a language tag and keep any explanation in a short paragraph above it.
